name: LanguageSwitcher
title: LanguageSwitcher
summary: Lets people read ism.bible in their own language: a globe "EN ⌄" button in the header opens a searchable list of language names in their own script, with a full-screen sheet on phones and an inline row in the footer.
whenToUse: Use the header button on every ism.bible page, left of Give.
Use the footer inline row in the footer legal area to repeat the main languages.
Use the mobile sheet below 1024px; the header globe opens it.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it to pick a Bible translation or reading language. That is the dot.Bible app (link to it from the menu foot).

anatomy.description: Mobile: `.nv-sheet` (with `.nv-sheet-grip`, `.nv-sheet-head`, `.nv-sheet-title`, `.nv-sheet-close`, `.nv-lsearch`, `.nv-sheet-row`). Footer: `nav.nv-finline` with links and a `.nv-finline-more` "More ⌄".

props.name: presentation
props.description: `menu` is the 320px dropdown under the header button; `sheet` is the full-width bottom sheet for phones.

props.name: searchable
props.default: true when there are more than 8 languages

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu wants to open or close.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the button, built from the current language's name.

props.name: heading
props.description: Visible heading above the list in the menu ("Site language").

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title of the sheet ("Choose a language"). Falls back to `dialogLabel`.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search field ("Search languages").

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the search field.

props.name: listLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the language list.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the sheet close button.

props.name: renderEmpty
props.description: Content of the empty-search message (announced with `role="status"`), for example "This site isn't in Oromo yet." plus a dot.Bible link. Receives the query.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer of the menu, for example "Scripture in 500+ languages" and a `dot.Bible ↗` link.

variantNotes: **Button:** 44px pill, 1px `rgba(255,255,255,.3)` border, white 14px/600 code. Hover `rgba(255,255,255,.08)`; focus blue ring + `var(--shadow-focus)`; open `aria-expanded="true"`, white border, caret flips 180°. After a change it shows the new code ("AM").
**Menu (`.nv-langmenu`):** 320px white panel, `var(--radius-ml)`, `var(--shadow-overlay)`, 14px below the bar, right-aligned.

**Option (`.nv-lopt`):** 52px rows; own name 16px/500, English name 12px `var(--gray-600)` below. Hover/arrow-key active `var(--blue-tint)`. Current: `aria-selected="true"`, name `var(--horizon-blue-dim)` 600 and a `.nv-check`.
**RTL rows:** `dir="rtl"` right-aligns; Naskh at 18px (19px in the sheet). The English name keeps `dir="ltr"`.
**Empty search (`.nv-lempty`):** "This site isn't in Oromo yet." plus a dot.Bible ↗ link. The input keeps its focus ring (`.nv-active` for docs).
**Mobile sheet:** full width, 20px top corners, 60px rows, 48px search. Tapping a row switches straight away; no confirm button.
**Footer inline (`.nv-finline`):** 13px `var(--text-tertiary-dark)` links; current is white 600 with `aria-current="true"`.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Write every language in its own script: English, Español, አማርኛ, Tiếng Việt, Kiswahili, اردو, မြန်မာ. Never use flags.
The button shows the 2-letter code only. The caret ⌄ means the menu opens here; dot.Bible links use ↗ because they leave the site.
Show search when there are more than 8 languages. Match own name or English name ("amh" finds አማርኛ).
Sort: current first, then by readers on the site, not alphabetically.
Picking a language goes to the same page in that language and sets `html lang` and `dir`.
Never use Horizon Blue fill here; blue is only for the current name and the check.
Keep rows at 52px (menu) and 60px (sheet); line-height 1.35+ for Ethiopic and Myanmar scripts.

accessibility: Put `lang` on every name so screen readers pronounce it; RTL rows also carry `dir="rtl"`.
The button has `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and an `aria-label` with the current language ("Language: English").
In the menu, focus starts in search. ↑ ↓ move, Enter picks, Esc closes and returns focus to the button.
The mobile sheet is `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`; trap focus and close on Esc, the close button or a swipe down.
content: Menu head: "Site language". Menu foot: "Scripture in 500+ languages · dot.Bible ↗".
Sheet title: "Choose a language". Sheet note: "Reading the Bible in another language? Open the dot.Bible app ↗".
Empty: "This site isn't in {language} yet. Read the Bible in {own name} on dot.Bible ↗".
